title: Rachio Rain-Skip Accuracy Review
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rachio:zone
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(result="skipped" AND reason="rain")) as rain_skips, sum(rain_mm) as rain_mm by zone _time
| where rain_skips>0
| sort - rain_skips
description: Uses Rachio rain-skip logs telemetry to monitor how often zones skipped because forecast or observed rain was present in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for whether weather-based watering rules are engaging often enough, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Rachio rain-skip logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly zone chart of rain skips and rainfall.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often zones skipped because forecast or observed rain was present so you can spot whether weather-based watering rules are engaging often enough before it becomes annoying.
